[F007] F007 is implemented and committed as `adabd04` (unsigned — 1Password commit signing is unavailable in this non-interactive session, so signing was disabled for this one commit via `-c commit.gpgsign=false`). I authored the operator-followable Buzz-as-caller recipe at `examples/buzz-caller/README.md`: the room-vs-delivery split, prerequisites (including the MCP server's registered-projects-only plan resolution, discovered during smoke testing), a tool map covering `list_projects` / `validate_plan` / `dispatch` / `status` / `approve_gate` / `read_evidence` with exact args and mutation flags, the full seven-step confirm-gated flow (preview via dry-run → explicit allowlisted-human approval → `dispatch(confirm=true)` → status polling → gate-pause surfacing → human-mapped `approve_gate`), and a safety checklist mirroring the ECOSYSTEM "Safety rules for agent callers" (same list the OpenClaw recipe uses) plus the locked Buzz non-goals, with the never-auto-confirm rule stated three times. The manual smoke checklist landed in the plan's `evidence/F007-manual-smoke-checklist.md` with all five executable steps (A1–A5) actually run and their outputs captured: tool surface, plan validation, dispatch dry-run default, approve_gate dry-run default, and gate status all behaved as the recipe documents, including the out-of-tree refusal check. I also added a pointer from ECOSYSTEM's Buzz-as-caller sketch to the committed recipe and verified every cross-link anchor resolves.
